I want the demo to show realistic latency/cost numbers and to run through your actual workload traces, so I think it would be best to move the public-facing demo by 48–72 hours to give the team time to finish ingest and the security checklist. Would a shift to Thursday or Friday this week work for you? If travel or calendar constraints make that hard, we can propose times next week.

Action items we still need to finish before the demo:
- Complete sample data ingest and validation (Connor)
- Confirm SSO + KMS integration and share access steps (Marissa)
- Update runbook with prompts and blackbox tests (me)

I attached the latest runbook and the sample data manifest for reference.

Thanks — appreciate the flexibility.

Best,
Ethan Park
